info.name: TTBS Live News Feed API (UAT)
info.description:
# TTBS Live News Feed — REST API (UAT)

The API behind the TTBS Live News Feed web app: upload company → PAM mappings, schedule AI research runs over them,
review signals, and deliver per-PAM digests by email (Microsoft Graph) and WhatsApp (planned).

Every example in this collection is a **real response** recorded from the application code (FastAPI app, real services,
parser and delivery pipeline) with fictional sample companies and people. IDs, timestamps and costs will differ on UAT.

## Quick start
1. Import the collection and the **TTBS · UAT** environment; select the environment.
2. Set `username` / `password` in the environment (current value only — do not share secrets in exported files).
3. Run **02 · Auth & Session → Login**. It stores `csrfToken`; Postman's cookie jar stores the `ttbs_session` cookie.
4. Call anything else. Requests that create things (upload, schedule, run…) store the new id (`importId`, `scheduleId`, `runId`…) in the environment.

Suggested end-to-end order: Login → Save provider config + Activate (once) → Save email settings (once) → Stage upload → Get dataset (until `checked`) → Preview → Save → Create schedule → Run schedule now → Get run / Run board → Outbox.

## Base URL & environments
| Environment | `baseUrl` | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| TTBS · UAT | `https://live-news-feed-uat.ai.tatatel.co.in` | Host NGINX (TLS) → gateway → API. |
| TTBS · Local | `http://localhost:5173` | Local compose gateway. The session cookie is `Secure`; over plain HTTP set `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=false` in `.env.dev` or use HTTPS. |

All endpoints live under `/api/v1`. The interactive OpenAPI docs are at `{{baseUrl}}/docs` when `ENV` is not `prod`.

## Authentication
- **Session cookie** — `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets `ttbs_session` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, path `/api`). No bearer tokens.
- **CSRF** — every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (except login) must send `X-CSRF-Token: {{csrfToken}}`. Missing/wrong → `403 csrf_failed`.
- **Expiry** — sessions end after the idle timeout (`idleMinutes` in the login response) or at `expiresAt` → `401 session_expired`. Run **Login** again.
- **Password change** — a user with `mustChangePassword: true` can only call `/auth/*` until **Change password** succeeds (`403 password_change_required`).
- **Permissions** — members get per-module `view` (GET) or `manage` (writes); admins pass everything. Each request's description states its access rule.

## Conventions
- JSON uses **camelCase**. Ids are returned as **strings** (e.g. `"id": "12"`); path parameters accept the number.
- Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC (`2026-11-18T06:00:00+00:00`); dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **Paging**: `page` (0-based) and `pageSize`; list responses are `{"rows": [...], "total": n, "page": p, "pageSize": s}`. Long `rows` lists in the saved examples are cut to 10 entries.
- **Sorting / filtering**: `sort=<columnId>`, `desc=true`, and `filter=<URL-encoded JSON>` — text `"acme"`, enum `["a","b"]`, range `{"min":1,"max":10}`, date `{"from":"2026-11-01","to":"2026-11-30"}`, bool `true`. Unknown columns → 422.
- Every response carries `X-Request-ID` (send your own to correlate) and `Cache-Control: no-store`.

## Errors
All errors share one envelope:
```json
{"error": {"code": "validation_failed", "message": "Request validation failed", "details": [{"field": "label", "message": "Field required"}], "request_id": "4f1c…"}}
```
| HTTP | `code` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `session_expired` | No/expired session cookie |
| 403 | `csrf_failed`, `forbidden`, `password_change_required`, `route_not_covered` | CSRF missing, no permission, password change pending |
| 404 | `not_found` | Unknown id |
| 409 | `conflict` | State does not allow it (e.g. run already finished) |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | Upload over 1 GB / body over the gateway limit |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | Upload is not .xlsx / .csv |
| 422 | `validation_failed`, `template_error`, … | Body/params invalid; `details` lists the fields |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Gateway rate limit hit (`Retry-After: 10`) |
| 503 | `service_unavailable` | Database unavailable |

## Gateway limits (UAT)
| Location | Rate | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | 6/min per IP (burst 5) + app lockout | 4 KB |
| `/api/v1/imports*` | 20/s (burst 40) | 1 GB (streamed) |
| other `/api/*` | 20/s (burst 40) | 2 MB |

## Scripts
The collection contains **no test cases**. A few requests have a small post-response script that only stores values in the environment (`csrfToken`, and new ids such as `importId`, `scheduleId`, `runId`).
